causal_contract.one_global_slot: One pending decision/open position across BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT per candidate; slot competition is resolved by decision time, then entry time and stable symbol ordering.
causal_contract.same_second_exit: Adverse stop has priority when a completed bar contains both stop and target.
causal_contract.source_boundary: An unresolved position at the end of a sparse source day is charged its full structural stop rather than deleted or favorably marked.
causal_contract.trade_bars: One-second bars are available only at sec+1. Swing bars are completed five-second bars.

conditional_next_stage.if_survivor: Freeze the family, reconstruct broader continuous pre-2024 data, then validate exact Bybit BBO/depth, fills, funding, structural exits, risk sizing and continuous NAV before any 2024 opening.
conditional_next_stage.if_zero_survivors: Register reusable negative evidence, keep 2024-2026 sealed and do not tune adjacent SMT/FVG thresholds.

data_contract.integrity: Raw gzip transport magic, CRC-readable CSV, row count, byte size and SHA-256 recorded before use.

families.logic: One market raids external liquidity while the paired market does not; the sweeper reclaims, opposing aggressor flow appears, displacement/MSS forms and optional FVG mitigation triggers reversal.
families.name: smt_sweep_reclaim_fvg_reversal

families.logic: The sweeper holds beyond liquidity with aligned flow while the paired market still has same-side liquidity overhead/underfoot; trade the laggard toward that pool.
families.name: accepted_sweep_liquidity_transfer

objective: Discover a causal, SMC/ICT-explainable Bybit USDT-linear perpetual strategy that converts correlated-market SMT divergence at pre-existing liquidity pools into after-cost reversal or liquidity-transfer continuation, with explicit information timing, one global slot, and no 2024+ opening before a pre-2024 economic gate.
prohibitions: No level already consumed before confirmation.
No same-bar favorable entry or exit ordering.
No missing-price interpolation or favorable source-boundary mark.
No credentials, option orders, paper orders, testnet orders or live orders.
No cumulative ranking promotion from this sparse trade-print fatal screen.

smc_ict_translation.SMT_divergence: BTCUSDT takes corresponding high/low liquidity while ETHUSDT leaves its own same-side pool unswept, or vice versa.
smc_ict_translation.external_liquidity: The latest causally confirmed 5-second swing high/low, or a pair of confirmed equal highs/lows within 6bp. A pivot is usable only after its right-side bars have completed.
smc_ict_translation.fair_value_gap: A causal three-bar one-second non-overlap created inside the completed confirmation window.
smc_ict_translation.invalidation: Reversal stop is beyond the sweep extreme; catch-up stop is derived from the distance to the unswept liquidity target. No elapsed-time position liquidation is used.
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_sweep: The first post-confirmation inside-to-outside trade-bar crossing of that pool. A level already crossed before confirmation is never treated as a new sweep.
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_transfer: If the sweep is accepted instead of reclaimed, enter the paired laggard toward its still-unswept pool after aligned flow confirmation.
smc_ict_translation.market_structure_shift: After the raid, price reclaims the pool and displaces away from the sweep extreme relative to prior completed one-second ranges.
smc_ict_translation.reversal_entry: Either the first trade 100ms after completed sweep-reclaim/MSS confirmation, or the first market entry 100ms after a later completed bar mitigates the FVG midpoint.
